g.text: DIFFUINO — COMPLETE BCD INPUT AND CONTROL CIRCUIT

g.desc: DIFFUINO — COMPLETE BCD INPUT AND CONTROL CIRCUIT

g.text: 1. BCD SELECTOR, INPUT FILTERS, AND VISIBLE BIT INDICATORS

g.desc: 1. BCD SELECTOR, INPUT FILTERS, AND VISIBLE BIT INDICATORS

g.text: D2-D7 are the UNO Q's 5 V-tolerant STM32 header inputs. Never connect this circuit to the 1.8 V MPU GPIO.

g.desc: D2-D7 are the UNO Q's 5 V-tolerant STM32 header inputs. Never connect this circuit to the 1.8 V MPU GPIO.

g.text: Firmware: 40 ms debounce; BCD is latched for inference; D6 is ignored while busy; D7 restores the ready smiley.

g.desc: Firmware: 40 ms debounce; BCD is latched for inference; D6 is ignored while busy; D7 restores the ready smiley.

g.text: Hardware validity: VALID = NOT [ BCD3 AND (BCD2 OR BCD1) ]

g.desc: Hardware validity: VALID = NOT [ BCD3 AND (BCD2 OR BCD1) ]
